newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nutricia withdraws baby product in France.
newsitem.headline: Nutricia withdraws baby product in France.

text.p: Food group Nutricia NV said on Thursday its Milupa subsidiary had decided to withdraw a small quantity of Lemiel 2 baby formula from sale in France.
It said it had done so in consultation with the French authorities after discovering that raw materials bought from an outside supplier had been tainted with salmonella.

Milupa withdrew a batch of the same product in France in February. In January it withdrew its Milumil babymilk powder from sale in Britain and Ireland because of a suggested link with salmonella infections. The powder had been made in France.
Nutricia said that given the limited scale of the product recalls it did not expect them to affect its profits in 1997.
